name: Moon Phase
author: cchapman
description: Current lunar phase, drawn as a small moon disc, for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Current lunar phase as a small drawn disc; hover for the phase name and illumination, click for a notification.

schema.label: Render style
schema.description: emoji uses the colour moon glyphs 🌑–🌘 (eight steps). draw paints a disc in the bar colour with a continuous terminator.

schema.label: Size (px)
schema.description: Glyph point size (emoji) or disc diameter (draw). 0 = auto.

schema.label: Hemisphere
schema.description: Southern hemisphere sees the lit side mirrored.

schema.label: Show illumination %
schema.description: Print the illuminated fraction next to the disc.

schema.label: Click command
schema.description: Shell command to run on left/right click. Empty shows a notification with the phase details.
